selectionGeneration.purpose: invalidate account-preference responses that began before a newer user selection
selectionGeneration.mustNotBeUsedAs: user/account identity, security token or server-authoritative revision

accountPreferenceReadRule: apply only when response generation equals current selection generation, there is no explicit current-session selection, and the response locale is one of en-IN/hi-IN
accountPreferenceWriteRule: capture current selection generation and supported locale in a sync intent; result is persistence evidence only and never changes the active UI locale
staleWriteBehavior: ignore result for UI state; keep current locale and do not let older response overwrite newer selection
syncFailureBehavior: keep current locale; expose a fixed non-fatal sync status to UI without raw server/error text
serverContract: NOT_DEFINED; this coordinator does not invent an endpoint, request envelope, response fields, or account identity
openDependencies: Browser/device restart and native locale negotiation require runtime checks; those are intentionally not run in the current code-only phase.
Account preference API/schema and cross-device synchronization remain pending owner decision; no API is called by this module.
